items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: He rehearsed on us about two weeks, you see.

ctx.x: On that old cakewalk and dancing with old people, you know. I didn't know the only one could do it, you see. I knew it. Mm-hmm. He got all that music. I don't know where he got it from. He said he remembered it, you see. And wrote it. Mm-hmm. And wrote it, you know. Mm-hmm. And now all our parts. Me, Pajou, Sonny Henry. Me, Pajou, Sonny Henry. And uh, Mario Pala. Yeah. Yeah. About six hours. Play.
What did the professor play? Piano? Piano. Professor Bobby? Yeah, piano.
He rehearsed on us about two weeks, you see.
